scope: M1 normal stock Resizable-Classic camera, measured through unchanged injected-client1.12.38; no free-camera/plugin option expansion.

source.qualification: Controlled offline native method readbacks; no original account, server session or network pump.

coordinates.height_sign: Negative is up; retain original source heights and plane/bridge flags.
coordinates.camera_api: Client.getCameraX/Y/Z are horizontalX/horizontalY/height; trace reorders them to X/height/Y.
coordinates.focal_float_api: Client.getCameraFocalPointX/Y/Z are horizontalX/height/horizontalY. Do not assume the same naming as camera integer getters.
coordinates.world_horizontal_position: world_base_tile*128 + local coordinate; do not follow actor tile coordinates as if they were camera eye coordinates.

required_state: Normal mode and source focus-entity identity, including the missing/unbound focus state
Logical20ms cycle, held native key states, native mouse button and previous mouse samples
Signed integer yaw/pitch motor velocities and the injected source legacy-unit velocity state
Target pitch/yaw in native units and float-radian target state
Float focal horizontal coordinates, source focal height and native integer readbacks
Actor render/focus coordinates, source plane, source footprint and terrain samples
Source follow-height offset and terrain-dependent minimum-pitch accumulator
Separate viewport-distance scale shorts, logical FOV settings, encoded FOV shorts and viewport pixel projection zoom
Camera FOV bounds/current values and native wheel-disable/configuration state
World base/rebase state, actual orbit eye coordinates and native render-frame elapsed nanoseconds

timing.source_authority: Unchanged tq.run calls mh.bs(20,1), then qm for each admitted source cycle.
timing.input_update: Original logged-in cycle calls zj.be(1161256214). The probe invokes only the isolated camera branch, not the network/game loop.
timing.render_update: Original client.ds obtains System.nanoTime elapsed time, normalizes actor interpolation by2e7 and calls client.ft(elapsed_ns), then client.dq(elapsed_ns).
timing.probe_boundary: The probe supplies controlled actor logical/render coordinates, then calls those exact camera frame functions with declared elapsed_ns. It does not claim actor movement interpolation or physical wall-clock pacing was measured.
timing.integration: Keep fixed input cycles distinct from render-frame updates. Do not substitute RAF-only constant angular speed or multiply the fixed-cycle acceleration by arbitrary frame delta.

keyboard.source_method: zj.be plus the unchanged client.vx input hook
keyboard.release: velocity = trunc_toward_zero(velocity/2); residual rotation continues until it decays.
keyboard.opposed_key_precedence: Left before right; up before down.
keyboard.native_target_update: Yaw adds trunc(velocity/2) through up.bc; pitch adds trunc(velocity/2), then kc.bk clamps.
keyboard.injected_frame_update: client.ft uses the legacy-unit velocities through client.rn, applies elapsed_ns/2e7, divides angle delta by2, and writes target angles from its float state. Retain both stages rather than double-applying one velocity.
keyboard.yaw_wrap: Native up angle wrapping uses one16384-unit turn; retain native float-to-angle rounding from the traces.
keyboard.release_example: Native negative yaw motor approaches -191, not -192, because of integer truncation. The source injected legacy-unit motor has its own truncation; it is not interchangeable with the native integer motor.

middle_mouse.gate: Original on.hd mouse-camera option; default source injected button mask0 does not introduce alternate buttons.
middle_mouse.deltas: pitch uses currentMouseY-previousMouseY; yaw uses previousMouseX-currentMouseX.
middle_mouse.native_motor: 2*pixel_delta converted through eg.ax (x8) in zj.be; unchanged injected hook retains its legacy-unit motor at source camera speed1.
middle_mouse.sample_smoothing: For a delta of +1 or -1, set prior sample directly to current. Otherwise use trunc((prior+current)/2).
middle_mouse.release: Returns to native keyboard/release damping; do not zero velocities immediately.
middle_mouse.qualification: Enabled and disabled source-option branches were explicitly controlled and measured. This is not an observed account preference.

follow.focus: The actual original CameraFocusableEntity render-coordinate getters, not the camera eye or raw world tile.
follow.teleport_threshold: If either horizontal coordinate differs by more than500 source units, snap both focal coordinates. Equality at500 still smooths.
follow.smoothing: focal += (target-focal)*(elapsed_ns/320000000.0), with original double intermediate and float storage. At20ms this is1/16; at10ms it is1/32.
follow.height: For an actor, source client.fa takes the minimum sampled footprint/center/corner height using source bilinear terrain and bridge-plane rules; client.dq subtracts8 and then the source follow-height offset.
follow.height_qualification: The controlled native player has footprint0 in these fixtures; the original function supports footprint sampling when nonzero. Actor render coordinates are explicit inputs. Terrain remains the original cache, not generated flat heights.
follow.terrain_pitch_floor: zj.be scans the source9x9 neighborhood, retains bridge flags, derives/clamps the minimum-pitch accumulator and smooths rises/falls with source24/80 divisors. client.sl source hooks and client.tz consume that state; target pitch alone is insufficient.

orbit_and_projection.effective_pitch: Uses source target pitch plus terrain/shake constraints, not merely the last input pitch.
orbit_and_projection.orbit: Original inverse pitch/yaw sine/cosine rotation of the radial vector, then subtraction from the focal X/height/Y. The eye moves when yaw/pitch changes.
orbit_and_projection.source_numeric_paths: cz.az keeps native integer/table calculations; client.tz publishes the original float-radian render camera. Both readbacks are retained in traces.
orbit_and_projection.separation_proof: Changing distance factors256/320 to320/384 moves the original eye while projection zoom stays410. Stock wheel changes a different FOV setting and follow height.
orbit_and_projection.resize: Native root161 layout and rl.cu are rerun. At the recorded controlled FOV,1024x768,1920x1080,2560x1440 yield projection zoom292,410,547 without relocating the focal world point.
orbit_and_projection.fixture_warning: The older five chosen fixed cameras and their zoom662 viewport-only path remain chosen fixture evidence, never spawn/arrival defaults.

wheel.source_route: Original tc MouseWheelEvent accumulator -> pq.as/qs wheel input -> root161:1 native listener39 -> script42 and original viewport opcodes.
wheel.listener_argument: Native event mouseY is wheel rotation; the real source listener includes sentinel -2147483646.
wheel.matching_runtime_overlays: Actual loaded39/1049 overlays and original payload hashes are both retained; no camera plugin override changes their source callback defaults.
wheel.logical_change: Subtract wheel_rotation*25 from the native inverse-decoded logical FOV values, clamp through script42, and retain native conversion/rounding. This is not a constant increment of pixel projection zoom.
wheel.effects: Changes encoded FOV/projection and source follow-height offset via script42/opcode5530. Native orbit-distance scale fi/fb is unchanged by these wheel events.
wheel.gates: Original pointer/widget routing, source varbits6357 and4606, and native disabled state remain part of the contract. Sidebar wheel did not change camera settings.

source_named_preset.qualification: Exact source-coded preset, invoked as a controlled probe; not asserted as the authenticated startup choice.

wheel.configurable_bounds: Scripts603/604 accept four integers and forward to605, which writes Varcs1338..1341. Their actual source-session arguments are not supplied by this offline task.
wheel.current_values: Varcs73/74 retain logical current settings after script42. Full-HUD helper-only setup leaves them -1 and bound fields0; that partial setup is not a usable source-session zoom default.

initial_and_reset_provenance.classification: Client class/constructor defaults only; not a valid world-space spawn eye or observed account preference.
initial_and_reset_provenance.region_transition: Original client.yk(rl4) subtracts128*base_delta_tiles from local actor, camera and focal coordinates, preserving absolute world coordinates; it resets camera_locked tofalse. Native +8/+8 and reverse transitions were measured.
initial_and_reset_provenance.controlled_recenter: The original follow path snaps when the focus displacement exceeds500; source target/cycle state is retained, not reset to a chosen capture.
genuine_unknowns: Authenticated Tutorial/Lumbridge first camera focus/angle/position and any incoming camera/CS2 overrides for the normal account/experience branch.
The actual startup invocation/arguments of configurable zoom-bounds scripts603/604/605 versus source preset626, and session/persisted current FOV values.
The source account's initial mouse-camera preference and any camera reset packets around spawn, departure or arrival.
initial_and_reset_provenance.not_requested: No source-account credentials, login, network-pump run or broad freshness research is needed or requested by this handoff.

downstream_requirements.owner: Rust/WASM camera/world/input state, with browser event transport only
downstream_requirements.existing_shell_shape: SourceCameraControls scalar rates/minmax/zoom-per-step cannot represent this stateful contract. Do not fill camera:null/controls:null with fixture positions or familiar constants.
downstream_requirements.integration: Implement/validate the separate fixed-cycle motor, source frame follow/orbit, native FOV program, terrain sampling and region rebasing against the exact traces. Supply justified initial focus/state/configuration separately.
downstream_requirements.normal_entry_gate: Remain explicit about missing source-session initialization facts. The class defaults and controlled probe coordinates do not authorize inventing Tutorial/Lumbridge entry cameras.
